protocol.cache_scope: warm infrastructure; no global cache clearing

scope: 同一产品字节；仅两个 FC 私有盘配置字段变化
两逻辑执行节点位于同一 BareMetal；每次 reload 在原逻辑节点，非跨物理主机性能
十对 AB/BA；两个节点按组交替，节点与先后顺序相关，不能分别估计这两个效应
每实例两轮相关状态；64 次 fsync 为实例内相关操作，按实例与配对统计
自然/温基础设施缓存，无宿主缓存清理；不表示全冷对象读取量
旧测量 fixture 与本轮试跑均不合并；未对 E2B/AgentEnv/Cube 做同条件复测

data.scope: same image and memory mode; only FC RWFS backend differs; guest I/O clocks; warm infrastructure caches; two rounds clustered per instance
data.create_clock_scope: SDK constructor only; excludes post-create RGW query

guest_io.clock_scope: guest monotonic clock; excludes SDK RPC, buffer generation and final verification; total sequential includes create/write/file fsync/directory fsync

data.root_write_fsync_scope: guest monotonic create/write/file+directory fsync; excludes generation, SDK RPC and random overwrites
